subject.title: [Bug]: Sandbox prune does not clean up workspace directory

question: Should this focused prune-workspace cleanup be handled inside the broader managed sandbox lifecycle PR, or should maintainers land a narrow prune fix independently?
rationale: The bug is clear, but cleanup is destructive sandbox state handling and there are competing implementation paths: a conflicting fork PR plus a broad maintainer draft PR with lifecycle semantics.

options.title: Fold into managed lifecycle PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98766 as the owner-approved path if it explicitly covers idle/age prune workspace cleanup and refreshes exact-head proof.

options.title: Land a narrow prune fix
options.body: Adopt a focused fix that removes only non-shared local sandbox workspaces after successful runtime cleanup and adds regression coverage for shared, rw, browser, and backend safety.

options.title: Pause until stale fork is resolved
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR first so there is one canonical implementation path before dispatching more repair work.

recommendation.title: Fold into managed lifecycle PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98766 as the owner-approved path if it explicitly covers idle/age prune workspace cleanup and refreshes exact-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This account owns the broader managed sandbox lifecycle issue/PR and has the strongest sandbox cleanup history in the touched files.
